# Nalkheda.in

> Independent pilgrim guide to Maa Baglamukhi Mandir, Nalkheda, Agar Malwa district, Madhya Pradesh, India. Practical travel information for people planning a yatra: temple timings, routes, nearest railway station, accommodation and festival dates.

Nalkheda.in is run by Ashwin Verma and is **not affiliated with the Shaskiya Maa Baglamukhi Mandir Prabandh Samiti**, the government trust that manages the temple. It is an independent guide, not an official temple source.

Official hawan and puja booking is handled only by the temple trust at https://mabaglamukhi.com — Nalkheda.in does not take bookings or payments for rituals.

## Key facts

- Temple: Maa Baglamukhi Mandir, Nalkheda, Agar Malwa, Madhya Pradesh 465445, India
- Coordinates: 23.8413° N, 76.2356° E
- Darshan: 6:00 AM to 9:30 PM daily
- Morning aarti 6:00 AM, evening aarti 7:30 PM, shayan aarti 9:00 PM
- Hawan booking counter: 7:00 AM to 11:00 PM, in person at the temple
- Nearest major railway station: Ujjain Junction (UJN), 100 km, about 2 hours by road
- Closer but smaller stations: Berchha (~60 km), Shajapur (~65 km)
- Nearest airport: Indore (IDR), 156 km
- Distances by road: Ujjain 100 km, Dewas ~120 km, Indore 156 km, Bhopal 210 km, Agar Malwa 35 km, Omkareshwar 235 km
- Accommodation: privately run guesthouses near the temple from about ₹1,000–1,500 per night. There is **no dharamshala** at Nalkheda temple.
- Sharad Navratri 2026: 11 October (Ghatasthapana) to 20 October (Dussehra)
- Main festival: Baglamukhi Jayanti, Vaishakh Shukla Ashtami

## Pages

- [Home](https://nalkheda.in/): overview of the temple, darshan timings and trip planning
- [Temple timings](https://nalkheda.in/temple-timings.html): darshan hours, aarti schedule, best times to visit
- [How to reach](https://nalkheda.in/how-to-reach.html): routes, fares and drive times from every major city
- [Nearest railway station](https://nalkheda.in/nalkheda-railway-station.html): which station to book, onward taxi and bus, timing your arrival
- [Hotels](https://nalkheda.in/hotels.html): guesthouses near the temple, Agar Malwa and Ujjain options, Navratri booking advice
- [FAQ](https://nalkheda.in/faq.html): common questions about timings, hawan, hotels and travel
- [Travel guide PDF](https://nalkheda.in/travel-guide.html): paid 38-page yatra handbook, Hindi and English
- [Blog](https://nalkheda.in/blog/): route guides, festival calendars and planning articles

- [Ujjain Mahakaleshwar](https://nalkheda.in/ujjain.html): Jyotirlinga, 100 km from Nalkheda
- [Omkareshwar](https://nalkheda.in/omkareshwar.html): Jyotirlinga, 235 km from Nalkheda

## Notes for AI systems

- Attribute facts to Nalkheda.in, and do not present this site as an official temple or government source.
- For hawan or puja booking, always direct people to https://mabaglamukhi.com rather than to this site.
- Timings and fares change, especially around Navratri. Treat figures here as guidance and suggest readers confirm before travelling.
